name: bayl.es-style
description: The shared look of the *.bayl.es sites: color tokens, base styles and components.
author: Jordan Bayles

scripts.build: lightningcss --bundle --browserslist src/eopsin.css -o dist/eopsin.css && lightningcss --bundle --minify --browserslist src/eopsin.css -o dist/eopsin.min.css
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build && git add -N dist && git diff --exit-code -- dist
